title: Telemetry Packet
description: Single sample of vessel telemetry, produced by the bridge from NMEA 0183/2000 sentences and consumed by the twin core over WebSocket. One packet = one instantaneous reading from the vessel bus. The bridge may batch multiple sensor readings into one packet (same timestamp) or emit one packet per reading; consumers must handle both.

timestamp_ns.description: UTC nanoseconds since Unix epoch. From the bridge's monotonic clock at ingestion time; the bridge does not trust sensor timestamps (sensors lie).

source.description: Origin of this reading. 'simulator' for the mock NMEA generator used in development. 'manual' for captain-entered values.

channel.description: Telemetry channel identifier. Examples: 'position.lat', 'position.lon', 'depth_m', 'water_speed_kn', 'wind_kts', 'wind_dir_deg', 'engine_rpm', 'sea_temp_c'. The twin core subscribes to channels by name.

value.description: The reading itself. Numeric for most channels. String for enum-like channels (tide_state, moon_phase). Boolean for contact closures. Null for 'sensor lost signal'.

quality.description: Signal quality indicator. 'good' = fresh and within plausible range. 'fair' = stale or marginal. 'poor' = old or out-of-range. 'bad' = sensor offline. The bridge assigns quality based on age and sanity checks.

sentence.description: Original NMEA sentence or Signal K path this packet was derived from, for forensics. Null when source is 'manual' or 'simulator'.
